objective_value: <float> Total operating cost ($) over the planning horizon, comprising no-load costs, piecewise linear production costs, and startup costs.

<generator_id>.u: <list[int], length num_time_periods> Whether the generator is on (1) or off (0) in each time period.
<generator_id>.p: <list[float], length num_time_periods> Power output (MW) of the generator in each time period.
<generator_id>.pb: <list[float], length num_time_periods> Maximum power (MW) available from the generator for reserve purposes in each time period.
